note: Generic cold-start pick-and-place menu over honest LIBERO signals (proprioception, finger contact flags, Astra keypoints). No task-specific constants; no grasp verification, placement correction or retry rules yet (left to RSI).
intent_instructions: Use the following priority rules to resolve overlapping intent definitions. When release_ready is true, select open_gripper. Immediately after open_gripper, select retreat. After retreat, if the episode continues and camera budget remains, select relook to locate the released object for another placement attempt; retreat alone does not establish success. When the gripper is closed and grasp_supported is true, preserve the grasp: lift if not lifted, carry_to_place if lifted and not above_place, otherwise lower_to_place. Recheck grasp_supported after lifting before carrying. A camera report from before closing does not establish grasp failure. When closed without grasp_supported, select relook if camera budget remains and the previous intent was not relook; after that look, a held report permits lift or placement motion, while an empty report calls for reopen_and_retry. Without camera budget, reopen_and_retry is allowed only when grasp_supported is false. When open, give at_grasp priority over above_grasp and select close_gripper. Otherwise descend_to_grasp when above_grasp or when continuing an aligned descent; select move_above_object to establish alignment. After repeated unsuccessful descents or repeated unsuccessful placement motions, use relook while camera budget remains instead of continuing the loop. Allow at most three camera calls and three close attempts. After a retry or a post-release look, use the refreshed estimates for the next attempt. Select finish only when the retry or camera budget prevents further useful recovery; finish is a stop, not evidence of success.

intents.name: move_above_object
intents.definition: Gripper open and not above_grasp: move above the estimated grasp point.

intents.name: descend_to_grasp
intents.definition: above_grasp is true and at_grasp is false, gripper open: descend to the grasp point.

intents.name: close_gripper
intents.definition: at_grasp is true and the gripper is open: close the fingers.

intents.name: lift
intents.definition: Gripper closed on the object and not lifted: raise vertically.

intents.name: carry_to_place
intents.definition: lifted is true and above_place is false: carry the held object above the place point.
intents.refpoint: vec(place[0] + grasp[0] - objc[0], place[1] + grasp[1] - objc[1], tcp[2])

intents.name: lower_to_place
intents.definition: above_place is true and the gripper is still closed: lower the object to the release height.
intents.refpoint: vec(tcp[0], tcp[1], place[2] + clear + tcp_at_close[2] - objc[2] + obj_h)

intents.name: open_gripper
intents.definition: The object has been lowered over the place point: open the fingers to release.

intents.name: retreat
intents.definition: released_since_close is true: raise the empty gripper.

intents.name: reopen_and_retry
intents.definition: The grasp failed (gripper closed but the object is not held): open and go back above the grasp point.

intents.name: relook
intents.definition: Ask the camera perception module to look again and refresh object/place estimates and whether the object is held.

intents.name: finish
intents.definition: The object was released at the place and the gripper retreated: stop.

predicates.name: above_grasp
predicates.expr: dist_xy(tcp, grasp) < 0.3*obj_h and tcp[2] > grasp[2] + obj_h
predicates.meaning: gripper is roughly above the grasp point

predicates.name: at_grasp
predicates.expr: dist_xy(tcp, grasp) < max(0.3*obj_h, 0.1*open_max) and abs(tcp[2] - grasp[2]) < max(0.4*obj_h, 0.15*open_max)
predicates.meaning: The fingers are sufficiently aligned and near the estimated grasp height to attempt closing, including a descent that stopped slightly above its target.

predicates.name: lifted
predicates.meaning: closed gripper is raised well above grasp and place heights

predicates.name: above_place
predicates.expr: dist_xy(vec(tcp[0] - grasp[0] + objc[0], tcp[1] - grasp[1] + objc[1], 0), place) < 0.3*obj_h
predicates.meaning: held object is roughly above the place point

predicates.name: grasp_supported
predicates.meaning: Both fingers currently contact something and remain separated enough to support a tentative grasp; persistence after lifting supports carrying, even when the last camera report said empty.

predicates.name: release_ready
predicates.expr: closed_cmd and dist_xy(vec(tcp[0] - grasp[0] + objc[0], tcp[1] - grasp[1] + objc[1], 0), place) < 0.5*obj_h and abs(tcp[2] - (place[2] + clear + tcp_at_close[2] - objc[2] + obj_h)) < 0.25*obj_h
predicates.meaning: The estimated carried object is aligned with the destination and the gripper has reached the release height; open here instead of repeating lowering or restarting the grasp.
